title: Weekly sync - serving runtime / infra / console — prep notes 2026-03-30
content:
Attendees (tentative): Maya, Evan, Diego, Priya, Sam (SRE), Lina (Console PM)

Purpose: prep notes / open issues to surface in weekly cross-team sync. Focus: rollout stability, autoscaling regressions, console telemetry gaps, and follow-ups from last week.

Quick status bullets (one-liners)
- Rollout that caused 2% error spike last week: mitigation rollback deployed, still monitoring; postmortem draft in progress (Priya).
- Autoscaler flapping on p3d pools for short bursts: mitigation proposal ready, needs infra validation (Diego).
- Console traces missing token-level latency for streaming sessions >30s — reproducer logged.
- KV cache hit-rate improvements showing +7% for chat workload in perf branch (Evan).

Agenda (30m)
1) 5m - Quick round-robin updates (who is blocked)
2) 10m - Autoscaler behavior on mixed-instance pools (Diego)
   - Show small flamegraph / timeline of scale decisions
   - Decision needed: temp pin to homogeneous pools? (pros/cons)
3) 8m - Console telemetry gaps & tracing plan (Lina / Priya)
   - Missing token-level latencies for streaming >30s
   - Short-term workaround: client-side sampling + synthetic end markers
4) 5m - Action review & owners, confirm owners + due dates

Prep notes / talking points
- Autoscaler: current hypothesis = noisy short-lived bursts from background eval jobs triggering scale-up then immediate downscale -> leads to pod churn and degraded KV cache locality. Diego to present logs and the proposed debounce window of 30s. Need input on cost impact vs. reliability.
- Rollout PM: we need to agree canary gating thresholds. Current canary uses p90 latency + error-rate(5m). Question: do we add model-quality regression metric from eval harness? (Priya: linking JIRA-ENG-324)
- Console: missing traces appear when SSE connection upgrades happen mid-stream. Sam flagged that nginx idle timeout interacts with our trace flush. Lina to propose config tweak and a fallback to client reconnect instrumentation. Potential customer impact: small but affects troubleshooting for long chat sessions.
- KV cache: Evan's perf branch shows better hit rates after moving to sticky routing for session-affine tokens; needs longer soak to confirm. Suggest a canary on 10% traffic for 48h.

Open questions (to surface)
- Can we accept a 30s debounce in autoscaler without violating SLO? (SLO lead?)
- Timeline for console fix rolling to Dedicated clusters vs hosted? Private deployments may need patch notes.
- Do we want to add model-quality eval gating to canary automation or keep manual review for now?

Action items (tracked)
- Diego: Run infra validation of debounce window on staging p3d pool, add cost delta estimate. Due: 2026-04-03. Status: in_progress.
- Priya: Draft postmortem for last rollout (include timeline, root cause, owner remediation). Due: 2026-04-02. Status: in_progress.
- Evan: Create canary config for KV sticky routing, run 10% traffic soak, report metrics (hit-rate, latency). Due: 2026-04-05. Status: todo.
- Lina: Propose console nginx/client reconnect fix + rollout plan (hosted -> dedicated -> private). Include customer communication draft. Due: 2026-04-04. Status: todo.
- Sam (SRE): Verify nginx timeouts and trace flush behaviour in staging reproducer. Add logs to linked artifact. Due: 2026-03-31. Status: todo.

Notes to self / scratchpad
- Bring up cost vs reliability trade-offs re: debounce: compute worst-case extra tokens served during 30s hold; rough calc: avg throughput 4k tok/s -> 120k extra toks per spike. Convert to $ with current pricing in Optimize dashboard.
- Remind to link PR for perf branch: GH PR 278 (ask Evan to add benchmark outputs to PR).
- Check with Trust & Safety if any of the streaming reconnection telemetry leaks PII when we add more client-side sampling (privacy review).

Linked artifacts to show in meeting
- Confluence: serving-runtime-weekly (notes + perf dashboards)
- JIRA: JIRA-ENG-324 (rollout incident)
- GitHub PR: serving-runtime#278 (KV sticky routing perf)

Parking lot / follow-ups for next week
- Evaluate adding model-quality metric to automated canary gating (small spike in engineering work, but good to discuss with product).
- Longer-term: autoscaler redesign doc (capacity-aware vs demand-aware) - schedule deep-dive next month.

Quick checklist before meeting
- [ ] Attach perf graphs to calendar invite (Evan)
- [ ] Share postmortem draft with SRE & PMs 24h prior (Priya)
- [ ] Confirm staging repro for nginx trace issue (Sam)
